Hi Asha / Jordan — thanks for the note and for sharing the questionnaire. Below are the items we can provide immediately and a short summary of our controls and timelines. I copied Rishi for any infra/engineering technical clarifications.

Artifacts we can share now (attached or via secure link):
- Redwood_SOC2-TypeII-Report-2025.pdf — our most recent SOC 2 Type II report (access controlled link below).
- Redwood_Incident_Response_Plan.pdf — high-level IR runbook and roles.
- Redwood_BCP-DR-Evidence.zip — executive summary of BCP/DR tests, RTO/RPO tables, and recent DR test notes.

Links / access: 
- SOC 2 report (secure link): https://redwood-secure-docs.s3.amazonaws.com/soc2/Redwood_SOC2-TypeII-Report-2025.pdf
- If you prefer, we can provide the SOC 2 report via our secure portal or under the standard NDA.

Compliance summary and answers to your bullets: 
1) SOC 2: Redwood has a SOC 2 Type II report covering Security and Availability for the period ending 2025-09-30. We can make the report available under NDA or via a pre-authenticated secure link.

2) GDPR / HIPAA: Redwood is GDPR-ready; we support data residency controls and data processing terms. For HIPAA: we will execute a Business Associate Agreement (BAA) where PHI is in scope — we have a standard BAA template and can route a DocuSign link once procurement confirms the requirement.

3) Incident response & breach notification timelines (high level):
- Identification & Triage: immediate; automated alerts and 24x7 on-call monitoring.
- Confirmation & Containment: typically within 24–72 hours depending on scope; internal investigation and containment actions begin immediately upon detection.
- Customer notification: Redwood's standard practice is to notify affected customers within 72 hours of confirming a security incident that results in unauthorized access to customer data. For incidents with regulatory notification requirements (GDPR), we follow legal timelines and will coordinate with your legal/compliance contacts.
- Updates: we provide status updates to affected customers at minimum every 24 hours during live incidents and a post-incident report when the investigation concludes.

4) BCP / DR: Our documented RTOs and RPOs for critical inference services are included in the BCP package. We run tabletop and full DR exercises periodically; the evidence zip includes the latest test report and executive summary.

Next steps we propose: 
- We can upload the SOC 2 report to a secure portal / provide under NDA. Please advise which you prefer.
- If you want a walkthrough, Marissa / Rishi can join a 30–45 minute call this week (afternoons PT). Please share 2 available windows and we will confirm.
- If procurement needs the BAA to proceed, we can send a DocuSign link today.

Attachments: Redwood_SOC2-TypeII-Report-2025.pdf (secure link provided), Redwood_Incident_Response_Plan.pdf, Redwood_BCP-DR-Evidence.zip

Thanks — happy to collaborate on anything else required for your security review.

Best,
